keep.quote: A group of researchers argue this is the real risk. No robot army. No evil machine. A slow handover of one small decision at a time, until people aren't steering (c13). They argue it; nobody has measured it.
They tried Dana's fixes in the model. Retraining. A basic income. Knowing about it. None of them stopped the race (c10). One thing did: a tax on the automation itself (c11).

An economist modelled a line. Start above it and you keep climbing. Start below it and you slide toward using AI for everything (c12). Two researchers at MIT built their own model and found the same split: the skilled get sharper, the rest lose the skill (c02). Both groups hold the same machine.
